reviews.text: Been eating these sandwiches for over 30 years.....OG location at Claremont Ave.

Hi Nancy,
We are unsure as to why you would feel it appropriate to leave us a review, we have never seen you in our clinic. Our only interactions with you have been limited to your job applications. You rescheduled your initial interview, abruptly cancelled it a few days later and then applied for an entirely different position.
After having viewed your history, it appears you have a habit of applying for jobs and leaving poor reviews for the business when they do not hire you. This is a curious approach to seeking employment and we are grateful to you for displaying your true character before going through the process of interviews and potential job training.  
Clearly, we are not a good fit for you and as stated in the response from Links Road Animal and Bird Clinic, we also “encourage you to reflect on how you communicate your frustrations. Professionalism and respect are crucial for constructive dialogue.” 
We wish you the very best in your future endeavors.

Dr Askari, Layla and the entire team at Parkdale Animal Hospital are amazing to deal with. We've been bringing our small dog Buffy for years (after some bad experiences at other clinics) and are so happy we go here. The team is always transparent about their prices which we greatly appreciate.

Our dog had to go to the emergency clinic the other day and the team followed up to check up on our pet. They really go above and beyond :)

I took my dog for the first time and he had his vaccines and physical! Dr toprac was very thorough, informative and passionate. She very patiently spent time to explain everything to me and was very knowledgeable!
When I had to call back the clinic because my dog was showing signs after his vaccine, dr asgari was very quick to get on the phone and explain everything to me for reassurance!
Finding professionals who are passionate about their job is very nice to find:)

Prepaid for appointments, but they wanted me to pay $70 if I missed one (so they double charge for missed appointments). Never went back and was never refunded the money for the rest of my paid appointments!

The team at Parkdale Animal Hospital have gone above and beyond for my senior dog who was recently diagnosed with diabetes.

We’ve had to contact them frequently with lots of questions and sometimes same-day appointments and they have done their best to accommodate us every time.

Dr. Askari has been our primary vet and is extremely knowledgeable, patient and kind with us and our dog. Dr. Doyle has stayed late to show us how to administer insulin injections and is very patient when our dog shows fear based aggression. Dr. Toprak has also walked us through many ways to address our dog’s diabetes and reactivity to the injections.

Their front desk staff are very helpful and their vet techs are super professional and friendly (shout out to Asa Kariya in particular as she has been an immense help to us!).

I really cannot speak highly enough of this team and am very grateful for all of their kindness and understanding. Your fur babies will definitely be in good hands at this clinic!

I have been bringing my cat, One White Whisker, to Parkdale Animal Hospital for 10+ years. My now senior kitty has seen various vets over that time, with his current regular vet being Dr. Askari (though he has had with visits with both Dr. Toprak and Dr. Doyle too).

I recently brought in One White Whisker because he was having tummy issues. I was extremely worried, but Dr. Askari calmed my nerves, provided One White with excellent care, and laid out different treatment options (instead of pressuring me to take the most expensive route - I can also thank Dr. Toprak with this one). Dr. Askari also continued to follow up after our appointments to make sure One White Whisker was on the road to recovery - which he was!

As a client for over a decade, I can't recommend this clinic enough. One White Whisker has always received top notch care and his mom (me) has left happy. Thanks Dr. Askari & Parkdale Animal Hospital!

We brought our dog, Cooper, here for many years. He was always treated very well and received very thorough care. When he got cancer, the vets were upfront about the severity of it and low chances of recovery. We appreciated their earnestness during that difficult time.

I just can’t say enough about the quality of care and support my cats have been receiving from everyone at the Parkdale animal hospital for the past 11 years!
Dr Toprak has been the main caregiver and at times Dr Doyle and Dr Askari have substituted. Every single veterinarian is top notch in their work. The veterinarian support team, Natasia, Saba, Asa, Kelsey, Britney, and Kristy, have also gone out of their way to provide support whenever needed, called and checked on my cats occasionally. Amazing! One of my cats has had many serious complications over the last 7 years, if it wasn’t for their help, referrals, care and support, I am not sure he would make it to this point.  Honestly my cat gets a much better care than I get from my own family health team.
Thank you Parkdale animal hospital and particularly Dr Toprak for all you do for us! We love you ❤️

What a wonderful team of professionalism and kindness,
Thank you Dr Nasrin for being our veterinarian.

Cold and Misleading Care
My experience with Dr. Ebru Toprak was deeply disappointing. In December 2024, she diagnosed my dog with a life-threatening cancer and told me to prepare for euthanasia if he stopped having bowel movements. She repeatedly expressed surprise that he was still alive, clearly expecting he wouldn’t live long.

After eight months of fear and nearly $10,000 spent on tests and treatments, she suddenly suggested the tumor might be benign. Her lack of empathy and professionalism were alarming. When I questioned her, she dismissed me, saying I didn’t understand probabilities. I am a university professor.

I’ve since moved my dog’s care elsewhere. Seek a second opinion before trusting this clinic.
